notes.title: Shop Simulator: Pet Shop - Release
notes.notes:
[h1]🛒 Greetings, Shop Owners! 🛒[/h1]

The time has come! After playtests and the demo, we are thrilled to finally release the full version of [b]Shop Simulator: Pet Shop[/b]! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225902/7ca4b6340ab517df8b9722587bae481540af59b3.png[/img]

[h2]A big thank you to all shop owners! 💛[/h2]

First of all, we want to give a huge thanks to everyone who participated in the playtests and played the demo. Thank you for your support! 🙏

[h2]What awaits you? 🐾[/h2]

In [b]Shop Simulator: Pet Shop[/b], you get to run your own adorable pet store! Help cute animals find a new home, take care of your customers, and design your shop just the way you like it.

We wish you tons of fun and can’t wait to celebrate your first successes as a shop owner with you! 

[h2]Got cute screenshots or feedback? 📸✨[/h2]

Feel free to hop onto our official 3RG-Discord if you want to connect directly with us or other players:

[url=https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3]https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3[/url]

[h2]Found any bugs? 🐛[/h2]

On our website, you’ll find instructions with all the information we need to fix any bugs you encounter. Here’s the link:

[url=https://3rg.eu/bug-reports/]https://3rg.eu/bug-reports/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225902/4e6d610ffacf5f5326941e8d05eac4cbad316044.png[/img]

[i]Best wishes,  
Three River Games (3RG)[/i]
